bootstrap.sampling: 20 instance clusters with replacement within each family

analysis.condition_labels_unmasked_only_after: all 880 attempts, artifacts, grader records, and marker-last evidence are committed and verified
analysis.family_weighting: equal because every family contributes exactly 20 clusters
analysis.missing_data: No imputation. Any missing, duplicate, unscheduled, instrument-origin, or environment-origin primary cell invalidates analysis. A model-origin terminal failure is a strict failure.
analysis.paired_diagnostic: exact two-sided cluster sign-flip distribution over nonzero absolute two-trial instance differences
analysis.repeat_handling: average the two binary trials within condition and instance

calibration.decision_rule: Every family must have 10 through 22 strict successes among its 32 condition-combined outcomes. Any family outside the band retires the complete generator version; no family is dropped post hoc.

opportunity_budget.rationale: The retired 14-call/4096-token D0 instrument exhausted its budget in 12 of 88 cells symmetrically; the successor raises both ceilings before calibration and freezes them for both conditions.

power.interpretation: The 220-cluster design is powered for a 12 percentage-point paired effect under the stated conservative correlation envelope; smaller effects remain estimable but are not a powered confirmatory claim.

primary.confirmatory_claim_rule: A directional superiority claim requires the two-sided 95% stratified cluster-bootstrap interval to exclude zero in that direction and an absolute point estimate of at least 0.12.
primary.estimand: mean over 220 instances of (harness_full two-trial strict-success mean minus native_tools two-trial strict-success mean)
primary.family_level_inference: descriptive only; no family-specific efficacy claims

sentinel.bound_interpretation: diagnostic only; the iid Bernoulli assumption is not used for an efficacy or deployment-reliability claim
